# Marawan Eldeib

> Software engineer and M.Sc. Information Technology student working on secure system design and LLM-based AI systems. Optimised NASA/DLR research software at the Institute of Space Systems, measured how LLM-integrated tools leak confidential data, and built and hardened a production full-stack platform. Currently writing my Master's thesis on GitOps-constrained agentic workflows (Oct 2026 to Mar 2027). Open to full-time roles in software, security and AI engineering.

Personal portfolio site. Available in English at [/en](https://marawaneldeib.com/en) and German at [/de](https://marawaneldeib.com/de); `/` redirects to whichever locale matches the visitor's language.

## About

- [About](https://marawaneldeib.com/en#about): software, security and AI engineering. Secure system design, LLM-based AI systems, network traffic analysis, and performance optimisation of research software.
- [Experience](https://marawaneldeib.com/en#experience): Student Research Assistant (HiWi) at the Institute for Control Engineering of Machine Tools (ISW), University of Stuttgart. Previously Working Student at the Institute of Space Systems (IRS), University of Stuttgart (SOFIA Data Center); Working Student, Fraunhofer, Apr 2025 – Dec 2025, testing and evaluation of LLM-based services; and an internship at Ikhlas Com Sdn Bhd (AirAsia Group).
- [Education](https://marawaneldeib.com/en#education): M.Sc. Information Technology (INFOTECH), University of Stuttgart. B.Eng. (Hons.) Computer Engineering, Multimedia University.
- [Skills](https://marawaneldeib.com/en#skills): security and privacy tooling (mitmproxy, Burp Suite, GDB, Nmap, OWASP), Python, TypeScript, Java, C/C++.

## Publications

- [Performance Analysis of Faster R-CNN and YOLOv8 Model for Mango Fruits Detection](https://doi.org/10.33093/jiwe.2026.5.2.17): Journal of Informatics and Web Engineering, vol. 5, no. 2, pp. 280-289, 2026.
- [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0009-0008-5285-424X): academic profile.

## Projects

- Master's Thesis: A GitOps-Constrained Agentic Workflow for System Manipulation (in progress, Oct 2026 to Mar 2027, IAAS in collaboration with HLRS): LLM agents change an HPC cluster only through reviewed pull requests, with code changes and HPC job submission controlled through MCP servers and gateways, applied by a sandboxed GitOps pipeline with audit trail and rollback.
- [Measuring Data Exposure in LLM-Integrated Productivity Tools](https://github.com/MarawanEldeib/privacy-analysis-research): measured what AI productivity tools send out from a confidential document without being asked, using an HTTPS interception proxy and planted canary identifiers. A paper with Prof. Dr. Marco Aiello is in preparation, targeting PoPETs 2027. [Video](https://youtu.be/CVnvyoWT5qM).
- [Saha](https://github.com/MarawanEldeib/saha): racket-sports booking platform with security built into every layer, with Postgres row-level security, a strict CSP, MFA-gated admin actions and signature-verified Stripe Connect webhooks. [Live site](https://sahasports.vercel.app).
- [Makhzan](https://github.com/MarawanEldeib/Makhzan): storage-rental marketplace hardened against common web attack classes, with httpOnly-cookie JWTs, parameterised SQL, IDOR checks and a documented privacy-by-design gap analysis.
- [Semsem](https://github.com/MarawanEldeib/semsem): voice-driven desktop AI assistant with a capability-based permission model, a destructive-command denylist and symlink-safe filesystem confinement.
- [MangoVision](https://github.com/MarawanEldeib/MangoVision): deep-learning mango detection from drone imagery; the basis for the JIWE paper above.
